title: Blueprint `sk-def-sp-trace`: the **trace map** `Tr_f : Rf_! ℚ̄_ℓ,X(d)[2d] ⟶ ℚ̄_ℓ,Y` of a morphism `f` smooth of pure relative dimension `d` (SGA 4, Ex
statement:
Let $\ell$ be a prime, let $k$ be a field of characteristic $p>0$ with $p\ne\ell$, and let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism between separated finite-type $k$-schemes [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting], smooth of pure relative dimension $d\in\mathbf N$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Put $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. Use the finite-extension-valued condensed coefficient ring $\underline\Omega$ of [prop-weil-pbc-qbar-condensed-two-colimit]: on a profinite set $S$ its sections are the continuous functions $S\to\Omega$ whose values lie in one finite intermediate extension of $\mathbf Q_\ell$. For $T=X,Y$, put $B_T=p_T^*\underline\Omega$ and $\mathcal C_T=D_{\mathrm{cons}}(T,\underline\Omega)$, the full bounded constructible condensed-module derived category of [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting], with inclusion $\iota_T$ into $D(\operatorname{Mod}_{B_T})$. Write $\mathbf1_T$ for its tensor unit. Use the actual condensed Tate complex $B_X(d)[2d]$ of [def-pur-condensed-tate-twists]. Let $F=Rf_!:\mathcal C_X\to\mathcal C_Y$ be the functor of [sk-def-sfb-dc-lower-shriek] for the chosen compactification, and $G=Rf^!$ its chosen right adjoint, with counit $\varepsilon:FG\to\mathrm{id}$ [sk-def-sfb-dc-upper-shriek].

Here is the construction of the normalized smooth trace, specifying all its input maps without referring to the smooth purity isomorphism defined from that trace. For $n\geq1$ put $A_n=\mathbf Z/\ell^n\mathbf Z$, $L_n=A_{n,Y}$ and $M_n=A_{n,X}(d)[2d]$. Take the specified finite diagonal/deformation-to-the-normal-cone purity maps
$$\phi_n=\gamma_{n,L_n}:M_n\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf_n^!L_n$$
and their quotient comparisons from [lem-pur-finite-smooth-adjunction-general-base]. Use the strict towers with quotient and root-power transitions, their actual derived limits $L=R\varprojlim_n L_n$ and $M=R\varprojlim_n M_n$, and their canonical normalized reductions from [lem-pur-condensed-tate-integral-tower]. Let $U_T$ be completed integral realization followed by rationalization and scalar extension to $\underline\Omega$, as specified in [lem-pur-condensed-exceptional-reconstruction]. Use its specified adjunction comparison
$$c_0=c_{f,L,M_\bullet}:U_XM\xrightarrow{\sim}G(U_YL).$$
It is the comparison of that lemma in case (b), with $r=-2d$; its input finite maps are the $\phi_n$ just fixed. Let
$$a:\iota_X(U_XM)\xrightarrow{\sim}B_X(d)[2d],\qquad u:U_YL\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathbf1_Y$$
be the canonical Tate realization of [lem-pur-condensed-tate-realization], respectively its case $d=0$ on $Y$ for the integral unit, followed by $B_Y(0)[0]=B_Y$; the latter is read in $\mathcal C_Y$ through the full faithfulness of $\iota_Y$, the underlying complex of $\mathbf1_Y$ being $B_Y$ in degree zero. The hypotheses of that lemma (membership of $M$ and $L$ in the completed integral constructible categories with canonical reductions $M_n$, $L_n$) are supplied by [lem-pur-condensed-tate-integral-tower]. These are the prescribed realization maps, rather than arbitrary isomorphisms.

Let $\mathcal T_d$ be the object of $\mathcal C_X$ with underlying complex exactly $B_X(d)[2d]$. Its bounded constructibility is supplied by the displayed Tate realization. Read $a$ as $\widetilde a:U_XM\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal T_d$ through the full inclusion, and put
$$c=G(u)\circ c_0:U_XM\xrightarrow{\sim}G\mathbf1_Y,\qquad \alpha=c\circ\widetilde a^{-1}:\mathcal T_d\longrightarrow G\mathbf1_Y.$$
Define the smooth trace to be the actual composite in $\mathcal C_Y$
$$\operatorname{Tr}_f:=\varepsilon_{\mathbf1_Y}\circ F(\alpha):\quad F(\mathcal T_d)\longrightarrow F(G\mathbf1_Y)\longrightarrow\mathbf1_Y.$$
This defines $\mathrm{AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.CondensedRing.smoothTrace}\,\ell\,f\,d$ with source $(\mathrm{boundedConstructibleLowerShriek}(\mathrm{Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj}(\ell),\ell,f))(\mathrm{boundedConstructibleTateTwist}(\ell,X,d,2d))$ and target the tensor unit. The definition has the counit form $\varepsilon\circ Rf_!(\text{orientation})$ of the blueprint trace map (`sk-def-sp-trace`) at $K=\mathbf1_Y$, with the orientation $\alpha$ specified by the finite maps and the reconstruction comparison above; no identification of $\alpha$ with the purity isomorphism used for `sk-def-sp-trace` is asserted here.
